paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the AttrEval-Simulation, as indicated by the chart’s title. The chart contains five slices, each representing a different data source. The “ENTITYQUEST” slice is blue and comprises 26.0% of the total. The “HOTPOTQA” slice is red and represents 24.2%. “TRIVIAQA” is shown in orange, occupying 22.7% of the chart. “POPQA” is represented by a gold slice at 21.6%, and “WEBQUESTIO” is a teal slice accounting for 3.6%. Percentage labels are located inside each slice, and a legend is provided listing each data source alongside its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest and descending in size.
